description: This file is a shell script designed to test Git's packfile delta optimization features, including island packing and delta chain rules. It defines functions to set up test commits, check delta bases, and performs various test scenarios to verify behavior under different island configurations.

methods.name: is_delta_base
methods.description: Checks if the given object is a delta base against a specified reference.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a generated random blob and modified content, updating references accordingly.
